sleeve_cuff_type.scope: Differentiated sleeve cuff only; not trouser cuff, hem or bracelet.
sleeve_cuff_type.proposal_status: Four initial types pending Mati terminology, distinctions and example review.
sleeve_cuff_type.combination_policy: Multi-label by sleeve component: each value needs its own evidence; ribbed may coexist with elasticated if both are verified. French vs simple button constructions on the same cuff require review rather than automatic double labeling.
sleeve_cuff_type.absence_policy: Confirmed absence of sleeve or differentiated sleeve cuff with evidence is NOT_APPLICABLE; obscured/possible cuff is UNKNOWN.
sleeve_cuff_type.technical_limits: Mitred/rounded edges and button count are detail variants, not additional cuff type IDs in this revision. No fiber composition follows from elasticated or ribbed.
